CREATE TABLE gold.dim_product
(
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    product_name VARCHAR(100),
    category VARCHAR(50),
    brand VARCHAR(50),
    price DECIMAL(10,2)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE,
    HEAP
);


CREATE TABLE gold.fact_sales
(
    sales_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    product_id INT NOT NULL,
    customer_id INT,
    quantity INT,
    sales_amount DECIMAL(12,2),
    sales_date DATE
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(product_id),
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);



CREATE MASTER KEY
ENCRYPTION BY PASSWORD = 'YourStrongPassword@123';



CREATE DATABASE SCOPED CREDENTIAL mikecredential
WITH
(
    IDENTITY = 'Managed Identity'
);



CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE raw_ext_sources
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://azureadlsgen2storage.dfs.core.windows.net/raw',
    CREDENTIAL = mikecredential
);


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT raw_csv_format
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS
    (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 2,
        USE_TYPE_DEFAULT = TRUE
    )
);
